title: Picking the Right Gemini Models, Building Design Systems & Auditing Agents
tldr: Gemini split into 3 models — pick Flash for everyday work, skip Flash Cyber unless you're gov/vetted.
Google says workplace AI reaches 68% of U.S. occupations but only ~21% of tasks — useful adoption benchmark for client talks.
OpenAI and Anthropic both shipped voice upgrades this week — a two-horse race is forming.

tips.heading: Gemini is now 3 models — pick the right one
steps: Everyday coding & document analysis → Gemini 3.6 Flash (17% cheaper output tokens).
Flash Cyber is gov/vetted-partner only — don't build workflows around it.
Access via Google AI Studio, the Gemini app, or Gemini Enterprise.

tips.heading: Build a design system before generating slides
steps: Write a DESIGN.md: colors, fonts, spacing (e.g. your !m palette).
Have Claude turn it into reusable slide components + a template.
Save standing rules in a CLAUDE.md so future decks inherit your fixes.

tips.heading: Audit an AI agent's decisions before you ship its work
steps: Before running a coding agent, lock the key decisions yourself (behavior, constraints, architecture).
After it finishes, have it list every choice & assumption — review that list, not the whole code diff.
tips.prompt: Before I merge: list every decision, assumption, and shortcut you made; rate your confidence in each; flag anything that only fixes this example rather than the general problem; and tell me honestly whether you'd stand behind this in production. Don't change any code yet — wait for my review.

news.body: Google's own data: workplace AI now reaches 68% of U.S. occupations — but touches only ~21% of tasks. Adoption is broad but shallow.
news.means: A realistic benchmark for client AI-adoption talks — frame impact at the task level, not wholesale job replacement.

news.body: OpenAI is turning ChatGPT into a business platform — adding ads, a small-business "agent" program, and a 3.2 GW data center in Georgia.
news.means: The assistant is becoming an agent ecosystem worth tracking for client solutioning — and ads in ChatGPT may change how you position/trust its answers.

news.body: OpenAI & Anthropic pull ahead as a "two-horse race" — both just shipped voice upgrades. Claude voice now runs on Opus/Sonnet with Gmail & Slack connected.
news.means: Directly relevant to your tooling — Claude voice + connected apps could speed hands-free work, low cost to trial this week.

news.body: OpenAI & Anthropic are lobbying Washington to restrict Chinese open-weight models (Nvidia's Jensen Huang is pushing back).
news.means: Interesting industry politics — but unlikely to change your day-to-day work in the near term.

beyond_ai.body: Fed holds rates steady, signals no cut before September. Markets had priced in higher odds of an earlier move.
beyond_ai.angle: Client budgeting conversations that assumed cheaper borrowing this quarter should be revisited.
beyond_ai.starter: Are we still planning around a rate cut this summer, or should we push that assumption out?

beyond_ai.body: A major airline reported record summer bookings despite higher fares.
beyond_ai.angle: No direct relevance to your work, general awareness only.
beyond_ai.starter: Anyone else notice flights are packed and pricier this summer, but people are still booking?

beyond_ai.body: A large retailer announced a round of corporate layoffs tied to AI-driven automation of back-office roles.
beyond_ai.angle: Directly relevant — a live example to reference when advising clients on AI-driven workforce planning.
